facts.fact: 引导的手肘与后腰是认领式的触碰——她发现自己不知何时不再介意了。
facts.anchor: I knew a claiming touch when I felt it.

facts.fact: 第一夜他守在自己那侧，滚过床垫、醒来脸贴他胸口的人是她。
facts.anchor: I was the one who'd somehow ended up rolling across the mattress in my sleep

facts.fact: 记忆重排：那夜想停的是他、索要更多的是她——疼痛记忆的锐角已软化。
facts.anchor: He'd been the one trying to stop. I'd been the one demanding more.

facts.fact: Mei Ling 对儿子的赞许让她胸口发紧——近乎嫉妒：她母亲从没给过这种不设条件的温暖。
facts.anchor: It was something dangerously close to envy.

facts.fact: Sorsha 来电不问安危只要结果，周末气泡当场刺破。
facts.anchor: The cozy bubble of the weekend popped

facts.fact: 章末汇报：她把日记里抄到的名字交了出去。
手机是故意落在婚礼上的——让母亲干等能给她快感。
facts.anchor: I'd left my phone behind on purpose. I'd gotten a thrill out of making my mother wait.
